# LZMA SDK decoder

This directory contains the ANSI-C LZMA decoder from the public-domain
[LZMA SDK 26.02](https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html) by Igor Pavlov. OpenXWA uses
it to decode the compact type-25 sprite payloads produced by X-Wing Alliance
modding tools.

Only the decoder and its required headers are included. See `LICENSE.txt` for
the upstream SDK notice.
